steps.text: Open **Accounting > Configuration > Electronic Invoicing**. Each company you may act in is listed with its reception status. Choose the company.

steps.assertion: The focused setup identifies the company by its SIREN or SIRET
steps.text: The setup screen gathers what reception needs: the journals, the accounts, the approved platform and the last self-check.

Choose **Run self-check**. Odoo uses its usual importer to create a temporary draft bill from a sample UBL invoice. It checks the supplier, invoice lines, taxes, total and original file, then rolls back the test records.

steps.assertion: The self-check passed without retaining test accounting
steps.text: Odoo keeps the result and the test date. Look for **Test passed** and run the check again after a setup change. Use the [activation guide](activate-electronic-invoice-reception.md) to verify the first live invoice from the approved platform.
